landing.hero_title: MDRank — Medical devices, ranked by evidence
landing.hero_body: Exact-model evidence for home medical devices, with Evidence Confidence kept separate from score and rank.

sections.heading: Evidence before rankings
sections.body: Published dossiers show exact-model evidence and Evidence Confidence. Numeric scores and category ranks stay withheld until the comparison cohort is complete.

sections.heading: Home blood-pressure monitors
sections.body: Public dossiers cover upper-arm home blood-pressure monitors.
